beats.label: S1 · The rubber boy sets sail
beats.text: Luffy, a boy who ate the Gum-Gum Fruit and became rubber, leaves his home village to become King of the Pirates, carrying a straw hat lent to him by the pirate Shanks.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Luffy's power, his dream, and the debt to Shanks that drives everything he does.

beats.label: S1 · First recruit at the Marine base
beats.text: Luffy frees the bounty hunter Roronoa Zoro from execution at a corrupt Marine base and Zoro joins his crew, the first swordsman under the straw hat.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Zoro is Luffy's right hand for every season that follows; this is where the crew actually starts.

beats.label: S1 · Coby joins the Marines
beats.text: To free Coby to enlist, Luffy stages a public beating so the Marines see him as an enemy, and the two friends part as future pirate and future Marine.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the recurring Luffy-versus-Marines dynamic and Coby's parallel arc.

beats.label: S1 · The thief who hates pirates
beats.text: Nami, a navigator stealing a Grand Line map from the pirate Buggy, uses Luffy as a decoy and betrays him, but cannot bring herself to kill him when Buggy demands it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Nami and the reluctant alliance that becomes the crew's next core relationship.

beats.label: S1 · Buggy the Clown falls
beats.text: Zoro learns that Buggy's Chop-Chop Fruit makes him uncuttable, but Luffy blasts the clown out of town after Buggy damages the straw hat Shanks entrusted to him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: First real Devil Fruit duel, and the moment that shows the hat is Luffy's untouchable line.

beats.label: S1 · Nami throws in with the pirates
beats.text: After Luffy avenges a dog whose shop is burned by Buggy's crew, Nami agrees to work alongside the Straw Hats, still refusing to call herself one of them.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Explains why Nami is on the ship at the start of the next season despite still hating pirates.

beats.label: S1 · A town saved, a crew afloat
beats.text: The townspeople turn on Luffy once they realise he is a pirate, and the three sail on toward the Grand Line with a stolen map and no fourth member yet.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the state the crew is in as they aim for the Grand Line, where season 2 opens.

cliffhanger.text: Luffy, Zoro and Nami have a map to the Grand Line and a shaky partnership, but no ship worthy of the trip, no navigator's tools for its impossible weather, and a growing list of enemies who now know their faces.
questions: Will Nami stay with a pirate crew she keeps insisting she has not joined?
How can three people survive the Grand Line without more crew and better gear?
What happens when Coby, now bound for the Marines, meets Luffy again?

characters.name: Monkey D. Luffy
characters.line: Rubber-bodied would-be King of the Pirates, wearing the straw hat Shanks lent him and captaining a crew of three.

characters.name: Roronoa Zoro
characters.line: Three-sword swordsman and former bounty hunter, the first to swear himself to Luffy's crew.

characters.name: Nami
characters.line: Master navigator and thief who despises pirates but is riding with Luffy after he saved a village from Buggy.

characters.name: Shanks
characters.line: The red-haired pirate whose arm was bitten off saving young Luffy, and whose straw hat Luffy carries as a promise to return.
characters.note: Appears only in flashback but is the emotional anchor of the hat.

characters.name: Coby
characters.line: Luffy's timid friend, now enlisted as a Marine after Luffy publicly cut ties with him so he could join.

characters.name: Buggy the Clown
characters.line: Pirate captain with the Chop-Chop Fruit, humiliated and blasted out of Orange Town but very much alive and holding a grudge.

beats.label: S2 · Into the Grand Line
beats.text: The now-larger Straw Hat crew rides down Reverse Mountain into the Grand Line and is swallowed whole by Laboon, a giant whale waiting fifty years for pirates who never came back.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Marks the shift from East Blue to the Grand Line, the world the rest of the show lives in.

beats.label: S2 · A log pose and a promise
beats.text: Whale-keeper Crocus explains that Grand Line navigation needs a log pose, gives them one, and Luffy vows to return one day to finish his draw with Laboon.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes how travel works from here on and plants a promise that hangs over the whole voyage.

beats.label: S2 · Whiskey Peak is a trap
beats.text: The welcoming town of Whiskey Peak turns out to be a nest of bounty hunters working for the secret organisation Baroque Works, and Zoro cuts through a hundred of them alone.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Baroque Works, the antagonist framework driving the rest of the season and beyond.

beats.label: S2 · Vivi's true name
beats.text: Two of the town's frontier agents are revealed as traitors: Igaram and Miss Wednesday, who is really Nefertari Vivi, crown princess of Alabasta.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The princess-in-disguise is the new passenger whose home country becomes the next arc.

beats.label: S2 · The warlord behind it all
beats.text: Vivi reveals that Baroque Works' hidden boss Mr. 0 is Sir Crocodile, one of the Seven Warlords of the Sea, and that he is engineering a rebellion inside Alabasta.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the villain the crew is now sailing toward and raises the stakes to nation-scale.

beats.label: S2 · Marked by Miss All-Sunday
beats.text: Baroque Works spies photograph Luffy, Zoro and Nami as top targets, and Mr. 0's partner Miss All-Sunday boards their ship to test them with an eternal pose that Luffy contemptuously crushes.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts the crew on Crocodile's personal list and introduces the enigmatic Miss All-Sunday.

beats.label: S2 · Coby and Helmeppo choose the Navy
beats.text: Coby and Helmeppo, taken under Vice-Admiral Garp's wing at Marine headquarters, secretly train through the nights, and Garp hides that they are friends with the newly wanted Straw Hat Luffy.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Keeps Coby's parallel Marine arc alive and quietly names Garp, who ties in later.

cliffhanger.text: The Straw Hats are sailing for Alabasta with its exiled princess aboard, knowing that the country's civil war is being manufactured by a Warlord of the Sea who has already put a target on their backs.
questions: Can a handful of pirates topple a Warlord who is impersonating a king?
Whose side is Miss All-Sunday actually on, and why did she offer them safe passage?
How much longer can Coby's friendship with Luffy stay hidden inside Marine headquarters?

characters.name: Monkey D. Luffy
characters.line: Straw Hat captain now in the Grand Line, sworn to deliver Vivi home and take her country back from Crocodile.

characters.name: Roronoa Zoro
characters.line: First mate wielding two new swords from Loguetown, strong enough to cut down a town of bounty hunters by himself.

characters.name: Nami
characters.line: Crew navigator learning to read the Grand Line's chaotic weather with a log pose, and shaking down clients along the way.

characters.name: Nefertari Vivi
characters.line: Crown princess of Alabasta who infiltrated Baroque Works as Miss Wednesday and is now begging the Straw Hats to save her country.

characters.name: Sir Crocodile / Mr. 0
characters.line: Warlord of the Sea secretly running Baroque Works and stoking a rebellion against Alabasta's throne.

characters.name: Miss All-Sunday
characters.line: Crocodile's calm, unreadable partner, who knows the crew is hunting him and gave them a pose to reach him anyway.

characters.name: Crocus
characters.line: Old lighthouse keeper and doctor to the whale Laboon, who gave the crew their first log pose and once sailed with Gol D. Roger.

characters.name: Coby
characters.line: Now a Marine oddjobber training in secret at headquarters under Vice-Admiral Garp, determined to earn a real rank.

characters.name: Monkey D. Garp
characters.line: Vice-Admiral who has taken Coby and Helmeppo under his wing and quietly knows they are friends with the wanted Luffy.
